audience: online sellers and accountants who handle tax and invoices with Quaderno

useCases.title: Find the tax rate for a sale
useCases.text: The AI calculates the VAT, GST or US sales tax rate for a product and the customer's location. Nothing is created in your account.

useCases.title: Review invoices, credit notes and receipts
useCases.text: The AI lists your newest invoices with filters and opens one for items, taxes and payments. It also lists credit notes and receipts.

useCases.title: List expenses and the jurisdictions you collect in
useCases.text: The AI lists the expenses (bills you received) and the tax jurisdictions where your account is registered to collect tax.

useCases.title: Look up, add or update a customer or vendor
useCases.text: The AI finds contacts and reads one, or creates a new customer or vendor with a name and details. It can also update an existing contact.

useCases.title: Create products or invoices, or record sales and refunds
useCases.text: The AI creates an invoice for a contact with items, or records a sale or refund transaction so Quaderno computes the tax. It can add a product first.
